coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 14 of 17 ground-truth variable items (82%), including consistent train/validation/test splits, sequence and prediction lengths, cycle length, model types, input/output dimensions, RevIN usage, batch size, synthetic-data parameters, normalization, cycle indexing, MSE, MAE, and loss-curve visualizations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW rather than the specified Adam optimizer and varies training settings instead of maintaining the stated controls. Specifies 50–100 synthetic-data epochs and 10–20 public-data epochs rather than 30. Does not specify the required single RTX 4090 with 24GB memory, instead reporting unavailable GPU execution. Visualization coverage is partial: loss curves are included, but learned cyclic-pattern plots are not clearly specified.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion describing a trained CycleNet capable of accurate forecasting and visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
